feat(admin): migrate universal resource pages

Summary:
- add backend models, migrations, services, and admin routes for webpage,
  home-image, and general-group resources
- add frontend routes, APIs, and migrated views for webpage, home-image,
  and general-group management, including hidden child pages
- wire banner detail navigation to a hidden route so item management matches
  the migrated route structure

Rationale:
- DAM-24 requires the legacy universal resource admin pages to be available
  in the aynguide admin surface with the same basic configuration flows
- the target app was missing backend persistence and route exposure for these
  resource types, so both API and UI layers had to be migrated together

Tests:
- cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-24/aynguide/api && npm run build
- cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-24/aynguide/frontend && pnpm build
- cd /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-24/aynguide/frontend && pnpm exec eslint src/api/types.ts src/i18n/chinese.ts src/router/modules/apps.ts src/views/banner/item.vue src/views/banner/manage.vue src/api/webpage.ts src/api/home-image.ts src/api/general-group.ts src/views/webpage/index.vue src/views/webpage/group.vue src/views/webpage/webpage.vue src/views/home-image/index.vue src/views/general-group/constants.ts src/views/general-group/index.vue src/views/general-group/group.vue src/views/general-group/filter.vue src/views/general-group/text.vue src/views/general-group/copywriting.vue src/views/general-group/border.vue
